name: Polarised relay coil
summary: A polarised relay has operation or a specified response that depends on the documented electrical polarity.
description: A polarised relay has operation or a specified response that depends on the documented electrical polarity. Its terminal and polarity markings must be preserved when the drawing is rearranged.
readingNotes: The device polarity is established by terminal data, not by the left-to-right direction of a rung.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Polarised relay operation is different from merely fitting a suppression diode to an otherwise ordinary coil.
